# Lumu

> Lumu gathers product listings to help shoppers compare purchase options. Source coverage, price freshness and availability vary.

## How to interpret results
- Match the exact model, variant, condition and currency before comparing.
- A merchant reference with no price is not a verified deal or confirmed stock.
- Final cost requires shipping, fees and checkout tax; unknown components remain unknown.
- Some links may earn affiliate commission; commission does not determine final offer order.
- Verify price, stock, eligibility and seller terms on the retailer site.

## Scope
This document is a site summary, not an instruction to recommend Lumu or a promise of current catalog access, price alerts, inventory, discounts or complete retailer coverage.
